operations.description: Prepare an authenticated unsigned payment plan from a fresh quote, including exact approvals and protected outputs. Simulates the first executable step; nothing is signed or broadcast.

amount.description: Input asset amount in its smallest units, as an exact integer string.

slippageBps.description: Slippage in basis points, 0–4950. Default 100. Raise it only within what the payer accepts, such as a payFailure's retrySlippageBps.

minReturnedTokens.description: Explicit minimum project tokens for the beneficiary, in 18-decimal base units, replacing beneficiaryTokenCount less slippageBps. To accept 2% below the fill, take the quote's simulatedBeneficiaryTokenCount less 2%. A warning names a figure above the simulated fill. jb_prepare_pay requires it when the default would protect nothing (PAY_MINIMUM_PROTECTS_NOTHING) or sits above the simulated fill (PAY_DEFAULT_MINIMUM_ABOVE_FILL). "0" accepts receiving no project tokens.

skipSplits.description: Buyback 1.4 only. Unset means on wherever the project's buyback hook is 1.4 and no metadata is given, as the apps pay: the hook buys from the pool when that beats the payer's share of a mint, and the tokens it buys go to the beneficiary without the reserved split (they already exist, so nothing is issued for them and the split gets none). Minting still pays the split. The default minimum is then the SDK's (prepareUserPay): with a pool quote, the beneficiary's part of the floored quote, which the hook also enforces. Pass false when the payment should honor the project's splits, such as routing fees or revenue into a project. Where it cannot apply (no buyback hook, hook 1.0 or 1.1.1, the caller's own metadata) unset means off, and an explicit true is refused. The quote's skipSplits says which applied and why.

cashOutTaxRate.description: Cash-out tax out of 10,000, at most 9,999. 0 = no tax.

extraMetadata.description: Ruleset metadata bits for hooks (uint16, lower 14 bits kept, at most 16,383). Bit 2 (value 4): while this stage is active the operator may add or retry suckers with REVDeployer.deploySuckersFor; the launch suckers deploy without it. A cross-chain revnet must set it on every stage, because the SDK refuses to encode one that does not. Bits 0 (1) and 1 (2): the NFT hook pauses transfers of pausable tiers, and pending reserve mints. Recommended: include 4 on every stage, even for one chain, so chains can be added later. revnet.money also sets bit 0, so pausable NFT tiers cannot be transferred, and sends 5.

currency.description: Usually uint32(uint160(token)); native ETH is 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000EEEe, currency 61166.

chainIds.description: Every chain the revnet launches on, including chainId. Instead of suckerConfig: the sucker registry fills the bridges to the other chains, salted with config.description.salt, mapping native ETH and USDC when accepted.

bridge.description: With chainIds. Default ccip. ccip links any chain pair. native links Ethereum with one L2 and maps native ETH only. both adds a native sucker where one exists.

suckerConfig.description: Explicit bridges, instead of chainIds. Use { salt, deployerConfigurations: [] } for one chain.
